title: Shells and Configuration: How Tenants Are Configured | Orchard Core
description:
Each Orchard Core tenant has settings and a configuration that come from several places: the files in App_Data, the configuration of the host, and environment variables. To prepare tenants, override them and host them on several servers, you need to know where a tenant's files live and which source wins.

This video shows what a tenant is made of, how the layers of configuration combine, how to prepare a tenant before it exists, and how to read the configuration in your own modules. It also shows how to keep the files in Azure Blob Storage or in a database.

In this video:
• What a tenant is made of: settings and configuration
• The layers of configuration, and which source wins
• Preparing a tenant before it exists
• Changing a tenant that exists, in files and environment variables
• One database for every tenant
• Reading the configuration in your own modules
• Shared stores: Azure Blob Storage and the database
